recommendation_en: Kangaroo mother care (KMC) is recommended as routine care for all preterm or low-birth-weight infants. KMC can be initiated in the health-care facility or at home and should be given for 8–24 hours per day (as many hours as possible). (Strong recommendation, high-certainty evidence)
recommendation_zh: 建议将袋鼠式护理（KMC）作为所有早产或低出生体重婴儿的常规护理。KMC可以在医疗机构或家中启动，应每天进行8-24小时（尽可能多的小时数）。（强烈推荐，高确定性证据）
